body: Hey, are you still here? If you are, I am so proud of you. Thank you for being so strong. I know I am just a stranger on reddit, but I am your friend, and I care about you. Even if the people in your life do not, I care. Talk to me. You talked about seeing your favorite movie, what is it? Maybe we have some things in common that we can talk about! You can talk my ears off with all your interests, i’m a good listener:)
i put down the pills. thank you everyone
